Class ConservativeRasterResampler.IntensiveStreamingAccumulator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.ConservativeRasterResampler.IntensiveStreamingAccumulator
Enclosing class:
ConservativeRasterResampler
public static final class ConservativeRasterResampler.IntensiveStreamingAccumulator extends Object
Streaming spherical-area-weighted intensive accumulator for ultra-high-resolution tiled rasters (such as NOAA ETOPO 2022 at $21600 \times 10800$) that cannot be materialized whole in heap memory.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

  • Method Details

    • addTile

      public void addTile(float[] tileFloats, int minX, int minY, int maxX, int maxY, int tileW)
      Accumulates one source tile directly using exact spherical box overlap.
      Parameters:
      tileFloats - row-major tile buffer of dimensions [tileH * tileW]
      minX - global source starting X coordinate of tile
      minY - global source starting Y coordinate of tile
      maxX - exclusive global source ending X coordinate (clamped to srcW)
      maxY - exclusive global source ending Y coordinate (clamped to srcH)
      tileW - allocated tile stride width

    • toGrid

      public float[][] toGrid()
      Finalizes accumulated weights into the target [dstH][dstW] grid.
      Returns:
